sources.name: Listed Buildings in Scotland
sources.intendedUse: Primary statutory designation, address, and spatial-reference source.
sources.curatorAction: Inspect current download licence and fields; filter to the reviewed project boundary; retain official identifier and access date.

sources.name: Conservation Areas in Scotland
sources.curatorAction: Verify current dataset entry, licence, and whether a local-authority source is more current for the project.

sources.name: NRHE Mapping Layer
sources.intendedUse: Archaeological and historic-environment site extents; supporting evidence, not a substitute for statutory designations.
sources.curatorAction: Import only current released data, preserve the source record ID, and distinguish site extent from exact building location.

sources.name: Clackmannanshire conservation areas and appraisals
sources.intendedUse: Alloa local conservation-area boundary/context and historic-character evidence.
sources.curatorAction: Request or identify a machine-readable boundary where possible. A PDF/map must not be treated as a georeferenced polygon until manually digitised, reviewed, and labelled with its method/confidence.

sources.name: National Library of Scotland historic maps
sources.coverage: Scotland and wider historic map collections
sources.intendedUse: Historic-map layers and evidence for reviewed settlement-age polygons.
sources.curatorAction: Record the specific map, survey/revision/publication dates, service URL, attribution, and redistribution terms. Do not export imagery unless the map licence permits it.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap standard raster tiles
sources.intendedUse: Current contextual basemap only; never the sole authority for historic facts or statutory designations.
sources.curatorAction: Keep visible attribution. Use only for normal interactive development/low-volume use; self-host or use a permitted provider for production traffic.
